title: Standard Chartered offers spot Bitcoin and Ether trading to institutional clients in UAE
dek: Standard Chartered announced it will offer institutional clients spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in the UAE, claiming to be the first major global bank to do so. The source provides no operational, compliance, or timeline details.
author: Crypto Cronkite
bottom_line: Standard Chartered's official announcement is the primary source for this claim. Readers seeking operational and compliance detail should contact the bank directly or await a more complete disclosure from the company or UAE regulators.
body: Standard Chartered announced it will offer institutional clients access to spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in the United Arab Emirates, claiming to be the first major global bank to do so in the jurisdiction.
According to Cointelegraph's reporting, the offering is described as regulated.
